:::{#cor-var-sum-indpt}
#### Variance of a sum of independent random variables

If $X$ and $Y$ are [independent](independence.qmd#def-indpt),
each discrete or continuous,
with $\E{X^2} < \infty$ and $\E{Y^2} < \infty$, then:

$$\Var{X + Y} = \Var{X} + \Var{Y}$$

:::

::: proof

By @thm-indpt-uncorrelated, $\Cov{X,Y} = 0$.
Applying @cor-var-lincom2 with

$$
\begin{aligned}
a &= b \\
&= 1:
\end{aligned}
$$

$$
\ba
\Var{X + Y}
&= 1^2 \Var{X} + 1^2 \Var{Y} + 2(1 \cd 1) \Cov{X,Y}
&& \text{(variance of a sum of two random variables)} \\
&= \Var{X} + \Var{Y} + 2 \Cov{X,Y}
&& \text{(simplify)} \\
&= \Var{X} + \Var{Y}
&& \text{(} \Cov{X,Y} = 0 \text{)}
\ea
$$

:::
